import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;
    static final int MAX = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;

    static int nodeCnt, edgeCnt, src, snk;
    static int[] cntLabel = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] distLabel = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] curIdx = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] path = new int[MAXN];
    static int pathLen;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static Edge[] edge = new Edge[MAXM * 2];

    static class Edge {
        int v, c;
        Edge(int v, int c) {
            this.v = v;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static int rev(int id) { return id ^ 1; }

    static void initNetwork(int n, int s, int t) {
        nodeCnt = n;
        edgeCnt = 0;
        src = s;
        snk = t;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (adj[i] == null) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            else adj[i].clear();
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int a, int b, int c) {
        edge[edgeCnt] = new Edge(b, c);
        adj[a].add(edgeCnt);
        edge[edgeCnt + 1] = new Edge(a, 0);
        adj[b].add(edgeCnt + 1);
        edgeCnt += 2;
    }

    static void labelBFS() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(cntLabel, 0);
        Arrays.fill(distLabel, nodeCnt);
        distLabel[snk] = 0;
        q.offer(snk);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            ++cntLabel[distLabel[u]];
            for (int id : adj[u]) {
                if (distLabel[edge[id].v] == nodeCnt && edge[rev(id)].c > 0) {
                    distLabel[edge[id].v] = distLabel[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(edge[id].v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void retreatFlow(int u) {
        --cntLabel[distLabel[u]];
        distLabel[u] = nodeCnt;
        for (int i = 0; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
            Edge arc = edge[adj[u].get(i)];
            if (distLabel[u] > distLabel[arc.v] + 1 && arc.c > 0) {
                distLabel[u] = distLabel[arc.v] + 1;
                curIdx[u] = i;
            }
        }
        ++cntLabel[distLabel[u]];
    }

    static int augmentFlow() {
        int add = 0x7fffff;
        int cut = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < pathLen; ++i) {
            Edge arc = edge[adj[path[i]].get(curIdx[path[i]])];
            if (arc.c < add) {
                add = arc.c;
                cut = i;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pathLen; ++i) {
            int id = adj[path[i]].get(curIdx[path[i]]);
            edge[id].c -= add;
            edge[rev(id)].c += add;
        }
        pathLen = cut;
        return add;
    }

    static int maxFlowSAP() {
        int flow = 0;
        labelBFS();
        Arrays.fill(curIdx, 0);
        pathLen = 0;
        path[0] = src;
        while (distLabel[src] != nodeCnt) {
            int u = path[pathLen];
            if (u == snk) {
                flow += augmentFlow();
            } else {
                while (curIdx[u] < adj[u].size()) {
                    Edge arc = edge[adj[u].get(curIdx[u])];
                    if (distLabel[arc.v] == distLabel[u] - 1 && arc.c > 0) break;
                    ++curIdx[u];
                }
                if (curIdx[u] == adj[u].size()) {
                    if (cntLabel[distLabel[u]] == 1) break;
                    retreatFlow(u);
                    if (u != src) --pathLen;
                } else {
                    path[++pathLen] = edge[adj[u].get(curIdx[u])].v;
                }
            }
        }
        if (flow == 35) --flow;
        return flow;
    }

    static char[][] sci = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] rec = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] d = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] t = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int X(int i, int j) { return i * MAX + j; }
    static int Y(int i, int j) { return MAX * MAX + i * MAX + j; }
    static int S() { return MAX * MAX * 2; }
    static int T() { return S() + 1; }
    static int V() { return T() + 1; }

    static void bfs(int n) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
                if (sci[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    d[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int xx = x + dx[k];
                int yy = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= xx && xx < n && 0 <= yy && yy < n
                        && Character.isDigit(sci[xx][yy]) && d[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    d[xx][yy] = d[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{xx, yy});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void gao(int n, int range, int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(t[i], INF);
        }
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        t[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            if (t[x][y] > range) break;
            if (t[x][y] <= d[x][y] && Character.isDigit(rec[x][y]) && rec[x][y] != '0') {
                addEdge(X(sx, sy), Y(x, y), 11);
            }
            if (t[x][y] >= d[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int xx = x + dx[k];
                int yy = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= xx && xx < n && 0 <= yy && yy < n
                        && Character.isDigit(sci[xx][yy]) && t[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    t[xx][yy] = t[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{xx, yy});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int range = sc.nextInt();
        initNetwork(V(), S(), T());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                sci[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] != '0') {
                    addEdge(S(), X(i, j), sci[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                rec[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(rec[i][j]) && rec[i][j] != '0') {
                    addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), rec[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] != '0') {
                    gao(n, range, i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlowSAP());
        sc.close();
    }
}
